title: Vlogger Norman Mangusin arrested anew
summary: Vlogger Norman Mangusin, who goes by the alias “Francis Leo Marcos,” was arrested anew on Thursday over the alleged illegal use of a police uniform, the National Police Commission (NAPOLCOM) said.
